name: bar_chart/default
description: Two bar charts rendered with BarSeries: grouped monthly revenue for three regions on top, and monthly profit colored by whether it meets a target below. Judge only content inside the plots; ignore the page heading, description, check boxes, and sliders.

checks.expectation: Two plots are stacked below the header, the upper one taller. Both X axes are titled 'Month' and show the twelve month labels 'Jan' to 'Dec', each centered under a group of bars. The upper Y axis is titled 'Revenue (k$)' and runs from 0 to 160; the lower Y axis is titled 'Profit (k$)' and includes negative values.

The upper plot shows twelve groups of three vertical bars rising from zero, colored blue, orange, and green in the same order in every group, with small gaps between groups. A legend in the upper right lists North, South, and West with matching swatches and does not hide any bar. The blue bar is the tallest in most groups, and the December blue bar is the tallest bar overall.
The lower plot shows twelve single bars, one per month, starting at zero. Most bars are green and extend upward; three bars (March, June, and September) are red and extend downward below zero.

Within the plots, axis titles, tick labels, and legend text are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, the check box and slider labels, or any text outside the plots. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
Neither plot is blank, corrupted, or drawn outside its plot area. Bars have straight edges, flat fills, and do not overlap other bars.
